messages:
alex (CEO): Quick note 1 All-hands Tuesday 11:00am PT. Agenda: 1) Exec priorities for Q3 2) Launch readiness checklist + embargo reminders 3) Policy tweak: external demo approvals 4) Incident & postmortem process improvements 5) Live Q&A. Add questions here or drop in Notion: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands-input. Recording will be posted after.

nina (CTO): Pls flag any infra or runtime topics. Were doing a short demo of the continuous batching improvement; if you want to show perf numbers, add a 1-line note.

maya (VP Product): Launch owners: put final launch readiness status under "Launch Callouts" by Mon EOD. Marketing + Legal sign-off required for any external demos.

sam (People Ops): Reminder: leveling calibration workshops start July 20; managers should RSVP. Also updating the referral guide (small policy bump). Link: https://hr.redwood/policies/referrals.

jen (Marketing): Embargo reminder: no external screenshots or feature names until we publish the press kit. If you're contacted by partners, route to #marketing-press.

rachel (Legal): Quick policy note: demos that include customer data require a signed NDA and Legal sign-off. If you're unsure, ping me directly.

deploy-bot: All-hands scheduled Tue 11:00 PT. Recording + transcript auto-upload ~10m after meeting.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks everyone. Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1798907777. TL;DR: 1) Priorities: reliability, Dedicated GA prep, and cost-per-token reductions. 2) Policy: external demo approvals consolidated (Marketing + Legal must sign off). 3) Ops: incident process tightenedfaster postmortems, action trackers, and SLAs. 4) HR: leveling workshops + referral bump.

nina (CTO): Technical highlight: continuous batching reduced median latency by ~8% and improved throughput on long-context jobs. We'll publish the short writeup in eng-notes.

maya (VP Product): Launch readiness: Dedicated GA window still target Q3. Owners: finalize runbooks and onboarding checklist. Marketing will coordinate beta invitations.

rachel (Legal): New approval flow: 1) Draft demo materials to #marketing-press 2) Legal review thread 3) Final sign-off from Product + Marketing. Expect turnaround target: 48 hours for standard cases.

sam (People Ops): Q&A summary: leveling doesn't change immediate comp; referrals apply to hires who convert to FT. We'll post an FAQ.

jen (Marketing): Action: I will post an internal launch playbook and the embargo checklist in #announcements. Please do not share materials externally until the playbook says GO.

alex (CEO): Items assigned: - Product: publish onboarding checklist and runbook by Thu. - Eng: publish batching perf note by Wed. - Legal/Marketing: finalize approval flow doc by Fri. - Ops: postmortem action tracker to be completed and assigned within 48h of any incident. We'll circulate consolidated follow-up doc by EOD Friday. Thanks all. :rocket:
